data.title: Rapamycin-FKBP specifically blocks growth-dependent activation of and signaling by the 70 kd S6 protein kinases
data.authors: Chung J; Blenis J et al.

evidence.label: Molecular — cells, biochemistry, structure
evidence.note: this describes the kind of study, not its quality

data.finding: Rapamycin-FKBP12 complex blocks growth-factor activation of p70 S6 kinase, linking the drug to a specific mitogenic pathway.
data.abstract_excerpt: The macrolide rapamycin blocks cell cycle progression in yeast and various animal cells by an unknown mechanism. We demonstrate that rapamycin blocks the phosphorylation and activation of the 70 kd S6 protein kinases (pp70S6K) in a variety of animal cells. The structurally related drug FK506 had no effect on pp70S6K activation but at high concentrations reversed the rapamycin-induced block, confirming the requirement for the rapamycin and FK506 receptor, FKBP.

extracted_findings.effect: Rapamycin blocks activation of the p70 S6 kinases; FK506 reverses it (FKBP-dependent)
